description: The new followers of a tracked account (list_accounts), newest first: handle, name, bio, their own follower count, when Mentio first saw them. Filter by range, from or to (on when Mentio first saw them), minFollowers, q (text in handle, name or bio); includeBaseline adds the followers the first read found. Cursor paged.

from.description: Start, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, from its first moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).

includeBaseline.description: true: also the followers the first read found. Default false: only new ones.

minFollowers.description: Only followers with at least this many followers of their own.

q.description: Text in the handle, the name or the bio.

range.description: A preset window ending now: 7d is today and the six days before, in `timezone`, as in the analytics reports. Ignored when from or to is given. Omit range, from and to for no window.

timezone.description: IANA zone that days in range, from and to are cut in (Europe/Madrid). Default UTC.

to.description: End, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, to its last moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: list_followers
title: List followers
